create_DistributedDataParallel: create a DistributedDataParallel wrapper around a PyTorch module for gradient synchronization across multiple GPUs
configure_DDP_mixed_precision: configure DDP mixed precision training with _MixedPrecision to cast parameters and gradients to lower precision dtypes
enable_DDP_no_sync: enable DDP no_sync context manager to accumulate gradients locally without cross-process synchronization
register_DDP_comm_hook: register a custom communication hook on DDP to define gradient aggregation strategies like compression or gossip
wrap_DDP_join_uneven_inputs: wrap a DDP training loop with join context manager to handle uneven inputs across processes without hanging
